products.name: Stockly
products.tagline: Demand forecasting and auto-replenishment for perishable retail.
products.description: AI inventory copilot for grocery and convenience retail. Ingests POS transactions, supplier lead times, weather and local-event signals to produce SKU-store level demand forecasts and draft purchase orders approved in one click.

features.name: Perishable-aware forecasting
features.description: Shelf-life decay curves per SKU; optimizes for sell-through before expiry, not just stock availability.

features.name: One-click replenishment
features.description: Draft POs generated nightly per store with supplier constraints (MOQs, delivery windows) already applied.

features.name: Markdown optimizer
features.description: Suggests dynamic discount timing for items approaching expiry to recover margin instead of writing off waste.

features.name: Shrink analytics
features.description: Attributes waste to root causes (over-ordering, delivery variance, planogram gaps) with store-level league tables.

proof_points.claim: Reduced fresh-produce waste at a mid-market US grocery chain
Improved forecast error (WMAPE) from 41% to 22% at SKU-store level
proof_points.context: Measured against the chain's incumbent ordering process.

proof_points.claim: Saved store teams 9.4 hours per week on manual ordering
proof_points.context: Self-reported by store teams during the pilot.

proof_points.claim: Cut stockout rate on top-200 SKUs by 27%
Typical deployment onboards in under 2 weeks
proof_points.context: Reads standard POS exports; no ERP integration required for phase 1.

competitors.name: ForecastIQ
competitors.notes: Legacy demand planner; forecasts at warehouse level and ignores expiry dynamics.
competitors.displacement_angle: Perishables-first, SKU-store level modeling with speed-to-value for mid-market chains.

competitors.name: ShelfSense
competitors.displacement_angle: Expiry-aware forecasting plus replenishment, live in weeks.
